prompts.title: Recent form — wins, draws and losses
prompts.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 scene, about 8 seconds, on a charcoal #101412 base, with the lower quarter permanently reserved for yellow subtitles. All on-screen labels are Spanish; hierarchy stays professional with exactly one focal point per variant.

Editorial variant — kinetic typography: JUVENTUS and STADE RENNAIS slam in from opposite edges in warm white #edf0e6 condensed caps, then the heading FORMA RECIENTE ticks across the upper third in lime #c5ed74. Three rhythmic beats follow: VICTORIAS pulses in lime with a camera push-in, EMPATES settles in slate #8ca6bf, DERROTAS drops in dimmed warm white; each word lands on the beat with a 2-frame shake and a quick echo, while abstract rounded blocks rise behind the type as pure rhythm, never as data axes and never as sample claims. Exit: all type collapses into a horizontal lime rule that wipes downward.

Statistical variant — grouped count bars: two team columns, Juventus left and Stade Rennais right, each with three grouped bars labelled Victorias, Empates and Derrotas on one shared zero baseline, unit partidos, common scale with slate whole-number gridlines so heights compare directly. Bars spring from the baseline with slight overshoot and count-up numerals resolved from {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}} and {{home.losses}} for Juventus, and {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}} and {{away.losses}} for Stade Rennais; a zero resolves as a flat baseline bar whose label stays visible. Sample treatment: chips under each team read Muestra: {{home.n}} partidos and Muestra: {{away.n}} partidos; counts are never normalized into rates, and if the resolved samples differ, the unequal samples remain visible on the shared scale. Source annotation in small slate caps: Fuente: Bzzoiro. Emphasis: the Victorias group carries a lime edge as the single focal point. Temporal stages: axis in, left column grows, right column grows, emphasis pulse, hold. Camera: locked-off with a subtle push on the pulse. Transition out: bars sink to the baseline and the panel slides up into the next block.

prompts.title: Goals for and against
prompts.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 scene, 8–10 seconds, charcoal #101412 background, lower quarter permanently free for yellow subtitles, Spanish on-screen labels, one clear focal point per variant.

Editorial variant — illustrative football pitch: a stylised vertical pitch drawn in slate #8ca6bf line-work fills the frame; a lime #c5ed74 ball traces a glowing curved path from midfield into the top corner and the net ripples with a warm white #edf0e6 flash as the stamp GOLES A FAVOR hits the middle third; the path then reverses in dimmed slate toward the own goal with the stamp GOLES RECIBIDOS. Tags JUVENTUS and STADE RENNAIS alternate as lower-third captions with each path. No numbers, no axes, no sample claims, no real match events. Camera: slow tilt following the ball. Exit: pitch lines retract into the ball, which bounces out of frame.

Statistical variant — paired bars: two pairs on one shared zero baseline and common scale, unit goles, unambiguous team labels beneath each pair and a compact legend top-right. Juventus: Goles a favor {{home.gf}} in lime beside Goles recibidos {{home.ga}} in slate. Stade Rennais: Goles a favor {{away.gf}} in lime beside Goles recibidos {{away.ga}} in slate. Entry: baseline draws first, then bars grow with count-up numerals, Juventus pair before Rennais pair. Emphasis: the tallest bar receives a lime outline as the single focal point. A secondary chip above the subtitle zone lists goleadores with their own source attribution: Woltemade {{home.player0.goals}}, Kolo Muani {{home.player1.goals}}, Ait Boudlal {{away.player0.goals}}, same unit goles, Fuente: Tabla de goleadores, no sample claimed for scorers. Sample treatment for the team bars: Muestra: {{home.n}} partidos and Muestra: {{away.n}} partidos, Fuente: Bzzoiro in small slate caps. Temporal stages: axis, first pair, second pair, scorers chip, hold. Camera: locked-off with a gentle lateral drift. Transition out: bars shrink into the baseline, the chip fades, and the frame wipes left.

prompts.title: Clean sheets — defensive records
prompts.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 scene, about 7 seconds, charcoal #101412 base, lower quarter permanently reserved for yellow subtitles, Spanish on-screen labels, one focal point per variant.

Editorial variant — stylised shield: a geometric shield built from slate #8ca6bf strokes materialises at center as a radial pulse of lime #c5ed74 defensive energy sweeps across its face; the heading SOLIDEZ DEFENSIVA locks in above in warm white #edf0e6 condensed caps; a second, dimmer shield slides in beside it while the tags JUVENTUS and STADE RENNAIS snap underneath. No numbers, no axes, no sample claims. Camera: slow push-in on the leading shield with subtle parallax on the stroke grid. Exit: both shields fold into a single lime chevron that slides upward.

Statistical variant — count bars: two vertical bars on one shared zero baseline and common scale, unit partidos, category label Arcos en cero: Juventus {{home.clean}} in lime and Stade Rennais {{away.clean}} in slate. A zero value renders as a flat baseline bar with its numeral and label kept visible, never omitted. Entry: baseline draws, bars grow with count-up numerals. Emphasis: the non-zero bar carries a lime glow as the single focal point while any zero bar keeps a hollow outline so the contrast reads instantly. Sample treatment: chips under each team read Muestra: {{home.n}} partidos and Muestra: {{away.n}} partidos, with Fuente: Bzzoiro in small slate caps; counts stay as raw counts and are never converted into rates or shares. Temporal stages: axis in, bars grow, zero callout, hold. Camera: locked-off. Transition out: both bars dissolve into drifting particles that fade before the subtitle zone, and the panel wipes upward into the next block.

prompts.title: Synthesis — scoring and conceding tension
prompts.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 scene, 8–10 seconds, charcoal #101412 background, lower quarter permanently reserved for yellow subtitles, Spanish on-screen labels, one focal point per variant.

Editorial variant — team reveals and narrative emphasis: the frame splits along a diagonal seam; JUVENTUS reveals on the upper half in warm white #edf0e6 with a lime #c5ed74 underline sweep, STADE RENNAIS reveals on the lower half in slate #8ca6bf, then the phrase GOLES MARCADOS, GOLES RECIBIDOS cuts across the seam in condensed caps, each word landing on a beat with a 2-frame echo while abstract diagonal light streaks reinforce the tension between the halves. No numbers, no axes, no sample claims, no forecast wording. Camera: slow vertical drift trading focus between halves. Exit: the seam flashes lime and the composition collapses into a center line.

Statistical variant — paired comparison: one shared zero baseline and common scale, unit goles, four bars grouped by team with a legend top-right: Juventus Goles a favor {{home.gf}} and Goles recibidos {{home.ga}}; Stade Rennais Goles a favor {{away.gf}} and Goles recibidos {{away.ga}}; lime for a favor, slate for recibidos. Entry: baseline in, Juventus pair grows, then the Rennais pair grows with count-up numerals. Emphasis: within each team the recibidos bar is outlined in lime so the tension between scoring and conceding reads as the single focal story. Sample treatment: Muestra: {{home.n}} partidos and Muestra: {{away.n}} partidos, Fuente: Bzzoiro in small slate caps; a Spanish tag HISTORIAL RECIENTE marks every figure as past history, never an estimate or a forecast, and no model estimates appear because none are supplied in the catalog. Temporal stages: axis, first pair, second pair, history tag, hold. Camera: slow zoom-out to fit legend and chips. Transition out: bars sink to the baseline, the tag holds one beat, then the frame wipes to the closing block.
